title: Reducedness ascends along a regular map of Noetherian rings
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Assume $A$ is reduced (every nilpotent element of $A$ is zero) and $\varphi$ is regular [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Then $B$ is reduced (every nilpotent element of $B$ is zero).
